When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2790-4836-6330.easyPrerequisites:
Angel of Destiny doesn't have summoning sickness.
Your life total is equal to or greater than 55 minus 4 for each opponent you have.
2790-4836-6330.notablePrerequisites: Opponents cannot block creatures you control.
2790-4836-6330.description:
Cast Corporeal Projection by paying {U}{R}, giving Angel of Destiny myriad until end of turn.
Declare Angel of Destiny as an attacker. Its myriad ability triggers, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Angel of Destiny attacking each other opponent.
Deal combat damage with Angel of Destiny, causing each Angel of Destiny to trigger, causing you to gain 4 life for each Angel of Destiny and causing each opponent to gain 4 life.
Move to your end step. The Angel of Destiny tokens won't be exiled due to The Master.
At the beginning of your end step, each Angel of Destiny triggers, causing each opponent they dealt combat damage to to lose the game.

650-710-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

222-527-5295-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5295-6495.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-527-5295-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Repeat

Gain life.

Repeat from step 2.

1368-1879-2033-6321.description:

Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1117-2866-6518-7646.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

252-1575-5330-5776.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra's second ability and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token. The Treasure will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur Food in addition to its types due to Displaced Dinosaurs and Ygra.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

2034-2048-4871-6201-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Sunscape Familiar.
Repeat.

141-2562-5147.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 5.

1978-3263-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers.
1978-3263-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat

5571-6798-6922--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
5571-6798-6922--6.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Blightbeetle and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

38-483-2173-5220.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

413-1636-6478-6730.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with toughness X or greater.
There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 3 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
413-1636-6478-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
When Sin enters, Intruder Alarm and Blasting Station trigger, untapping all creatures and Blasting Station.
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to Sin's toughness.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sin.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Arbor Adherent.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

222-413-527-6791.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-413-527-6791.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala enter, Slimefoot and Squee triggers once and Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve both Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2376-4659-5003-6554.manaNeeded: {2} if Mister Gutsy doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it
2376-4659-5003-6554.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mister Gutsy, adding {C}{C}.
When Mister Gutsy dies, its second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Mister Gutsy trigger, creating a number of Junk tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on it.
If you created a Junk token, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Junk, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Mister Gutsy from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

1548-3719-5147-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least seven creatures, excluding Port Razer, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Port Razer or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
1548-3719-5147-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping seven creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Port Raazer as attackers, triggering Luxurious Locomotive, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Deal combat damage using Port Razer, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Port Razer.
Resolve the Port Razer ability, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing four Treasures, returning Port Razer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

1445-2511-4871-5631.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2511-4871-5631.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

273-3621-4763-6068.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Dissection Tools by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, targeting Koll.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dissection Tools ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2178-4170-4871-5147.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
2178-4170-4871-5147.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Inkling.
When the Inkling dies, Fain and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Fain trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1475-4955-5147.notablePrerequisites:
One with the Kami attached to any creature you control.
Grafted Wargear attached to any creature you control except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
1475-4955-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with Grafted Wargear attached.
When the creature dies, One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to that creature's power.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Spirit token.
Repeat.

239-302-1636-2467-5072.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
At most {1} plus two mana of any two different colors available, plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
239-302-1636-2467-5072.description:
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding one mana of any color for each Sliver tapped this way.
Cast Sliver Grandmother from the command zone by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Sliver Grandmother enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers.
Holding priortiy, activate Sliver Gravemother by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding one mana of any color for each Sliver tapped this way.
Activate Sliver Gravemother by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
Choose not to return Sliver Gravemother to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Sliver Gravemother ability, causing each player to discard a card.
Activate Sliver Gravemother's encore ability by paying {5} and exiling it.
Choose to return Sliver Gravemother to the command zone from exile.
Resolve the Sliver Gravemother ability, creating a token copy of it for each opponent you have.
When the Sliver Gravemother tokens enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate the Sliver Gravemother tokens by tapping them, adding at least three mana of any color(s).
Resolve the first Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding one mana of any color for each Sliver tapped this way.
Repeat from step 15 for each remaining trigger.
Repeat from step 1.

1636-3621-4331-5256.notablePrerequisites: Drafna does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3621-4331-5256.description:
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard by paying {8}.
Holding priority, activate Drafna's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying the Su-Chi Cave Guard spell.
Resolve the copy of the Su-Chi Cave Guard spell, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
The token Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
The token Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling any player eight cards.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat steps 2 through 4 any number of times.

1263-4050-4314.notablePrerequisites: You attacked with a creature this turn.
1263-4050-4314.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield.
Repeat.
